name: Outland Wanderer
source:
Player is an outsider stumbling upon the continent of Mokken. In his attempt to travel back to his own Tribe, he bonds and form different relationship with the locals, tackles on unknown forces, and discovers his own destiny.

[From [url=https://fishsticker.itch.io/outland-wanderer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玩家是一个偶然来到莫肯大陆的外来者。在他试图回到自己的部落的过程中，他与当地人建立了不同的关系，对抗未知的力量，并发现了自己的命运。

[来自[url=https://fishsticker.itch.io/outland-wanderer]Itch.io[/url]]
